34:t_022:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「An Angel... eating an EVA? That can't be possible!」

34:t_022:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Something's wrong! The Angel's identification signal is changing to Unit-00's!」

34:t_022:4.en:
$$ミサト$$
「It got us! Its pattern is no longer an Angel's, so HQ won't self-destruct even if it enters $$セントラルドグマ$$!」

34:t_023:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units have deployed! The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ is standing by in $$相模湾$$ too!」

34:t_023:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Ha ha... Puppy... $c... You're a little late...」

34:t_023:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「It's... fused with Unit-00... It absorbed the pilot along with it...」

34:t_023:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's not... over... It still... isn't... too late...」

34:t_023:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「Ha ha... I thought you'd be more of a sulker... You've got fire in you, Puppy...」

34:t_023:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「But I'm sorry... Unit-02... has reached its limit...」

34:t_023:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'm leaving the rest to you... $$碇シンジ$$...」

34:t_024:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's going on!? Are $$サイデリアル$$ and the Angel attacking $$ＮＥＲＶ$$!?」

34:t_024:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「So this... is what $$千鳥$$'s bad feeling before we deployed was about...!」

34:t_024:4.en:
$n
($$千鳥$$ sensed something was wrong and went along on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...)

34:t_024:5.en:
$n
(The unease $$千鳥$$ felt... Is it the same as the foreboding inside me...?)

34:t_024:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You felt it too, $$バナージ$$...!」

34:t_024:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I can sense... $$レイ#pt394$$ inside that Angel...!」

34:t_024:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「Colonel $$葛城$$ just contacted us...! She says that Angel has fused with $$綾波レイ$$!」

34:t_024:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I...! I'm going to save $$綾波$$, no matter what!」

34:t_024:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll cover you! You head for the Angel!」

34:t_024:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, keep $$サイデリアル$$ away from Unit-01! We'll take them on!」

34:t_024:17.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Unit-01 has no cable connected! Its operating time should be five minutes!」

34:t_024:18.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we'll defeat the Angel in those five minutes!」

34:t_024:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll deal with that afterward! Unless we stop the Angel, we can't do anything!」

34:t_024:21.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$! We'll sweep those pests out of your way!」

34:t_024:23.en:
$n
「He's the $$サイデリアル$$ general we met on the Central Asian front...!」

34:t_024:24.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「This is our chance, General! Let them fight that monster, and once they're worn down...」

34:t_024:27.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「They are warriors. I have no need for petty tactics against them...!」

34:t_024:28.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Come, $c! I'll bury that monster and every one of those artificial humans myself!」

34:t_024:29.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And I'll dedicate that victory to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

34:t_024:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, be careful! $$サイデリアル$$ is targeting the Angel as well as us!」

34:t_024:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They intend to kill the Angel with $$レイ#pt394$$ inside! We'll stop them and rescue her!」

34:t_024:33.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$!! I'm coming for you!!」

34:t_026:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
「No, $$シンジ$$! The EVA is already...!」

34:t_028:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 has reached its operating limit! The reserve isn't working either!」

34:t_030:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming!」

34:t_031:0.en:
$n
「Get out of the way! If this keeps up, $$シンジ$$ will...!」

34:t_032:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「It's moving... Even though it should have reached its operating limit...」

34:t_032:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「I don't know... What on earth... is happening to Unit-01...?」

34:t_033:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's not the EVA we knew...! But it's not going berserk either!」

34:t_033:3.en:
$$ミサト$$
「The EVA had this much power...?」

34:t_033:4.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Unit-01 is going beyond the bounds of humanity...」

34:t_033:5.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Plug depth exceeds 180! It's already dangerous!」

34:t_033:6.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Stop, $$シンジ$$! You won't be able to become human again!」

notes: Rei is Ayanami throughout; speaker pid is offset, so speaker text and EVA scene determine #pt394. Shinji demands Ayanami back across the matching two-row boundary. Mari entrusts the remaining battle to Shinji; Bobby asks him to succeed while the squad clears his way.
